source.prompt: best mechanical keyboard under 3000 rupees with hot swappable switches
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
If you’re looking for a budget-friendly mechanical keyboard under ₹3,000 with hot-swappable switches, options like the Kreo Hive 65 RGB, EvoFox Katana S Mini, and Cosmic Byte CB-GK-43 Phantom offer great customization and build quality.
Top Recommendations
1. Kreo Hive 65 RGB Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
Layout: 65% compact keyboard
Switches: Pre-lubed, 5-pin hot-swappable
Features: RGB backlight, anti-ghosting, detachable USB-C cable
Pros: Compact design ideal for small desk setups, hot-swap compatible for customizing switches 2
2. EvoFox Katana S Mini Wired Mechanical Keyboard
Layout: 68-key compact board
Switches: Hot-swappable silent red switches
Features: Vivid rainbow RGB, 1000Hz polling rate, full anti-ghosting, wired design
Pros: Good for gaming, portable, quiet switches, hot-swappable for easy switch replacement 2
3. Cosmic Byte CB-GK-43 Phantom TKL
Layout: Tenkeyless mechanical keyboard (TKL)
Switches: Pre-lubed Outemu Red switches, swappable
Features: 1000Hz polling, per-key RGB with software, USB-C connectivity, volume roller
Pros: TKL layout saves space, software customization for lighting, great for both typing and gaming 2
4. Redragon K617 Fizz (60%)
Layout: Ultra-compact 61 keys
Switches: Linear red, swap-ready socket for mods
Features: RGB lighting, Pro driver/software supported, vibrant 20-mode lighting
Pros: Extremely compact, easy to replace switches, suitable for mobile setups or minimal desks 1
5. Ant Esports MK1300 V2
Layout: 60% wired mechanical keyboard, 61 keys
Switches: Hot-swappable red switches
Features: RGB backlit, anti-ghosting, detachable USB-C, PC/Mac compatible
Pros: Solid entry-level option for budget users, customization-friendly 1
Buying Tips
Layout Choice: 60%-65% boards are portable, TKL (87 keys) saves space, but no dedicated numpad.
Switch Type: Linear (silent), tactile (bump), or clicky (audible) depending on typing or gaming preference.
Hot-Swap Compatibility: Ensures you can replace switches easily without soldering.
Connectivity & Build: Consider detachable USB-C for convenience and keyboards with anti-ghosting for gaming.
These keyboards provide excellent hot-swappable capability, RGB customization, and pricing under ₹3,000, making them suitable for budget-conscious gamers and typists who like customizing their setup +1.
